column3: (Permissions Policy Header Not Set) Documented in public/_headers
(Cookie Without SameSite Attribute) Monitored for third-party scripts (Cloudflare Turnstile)
(Re-examine Cache-control Directives) Static assets use Vite content hashes; API calls use Supabase SDK
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments) Checked via check:secrets and Semgrep
(Server Leaks Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field) Managed by Cloudflare CDN edge
(CSP: CSP Header within <meta> tag) CSP is delivered via HTTP response headers
(Timestamp Disclosure) Benign build timestamps in static chunks
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration) Cross-origin resources restricted by CSP
(Modern Web Application) Single Page Application (SPA) architecture
(Anti-CSRF Tokens Check) SPA architecture using Supabase Bearer JWT tokens in Authorization headers; no cookie-based form submissions
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) Client-side React forms talk to API via Bearer token authorization; CSRF tokens not applicable
